leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a React shell component that serves as the main container for micro-frontends
Initialize and manage application state to control which micro-frontend module is displayed
Implement dynamic module loading using React's lazy and Suspense APIs
Configure routing within the shell to handle navigation between different micro-frontend applications
Integrate a navigation component that allows users to switch between micro-frontend modules
Render micro-frontend components conditionally based on the current application state
Apply error boundaries to handle failures when loading micro-frontend modules
